startGameTipDesc0.ch:
欢迎各位抢到饭票的道友！
为了顺利完成本次技术A测，请道友务必阅读以下须知：

1、【测试时间】
从2020年12月10日激活后，至13日23点59分。
请注意：14日零点开始游戏将失效。本次为删档测试，数据、存档均不会保留，请道友留意游玩时间。

2、【本次版本内容】
A测版本仅为EA（抢先体验）发售版的小部分内容，有如下限制：
\t①游戏时长为游戏内8年\t\t②地图中雷电沼泽等部分格子不可进入，请注意
\t③宗门可体验入门小比，正式玩法不开放\t④境界仅能突破到筑基初期

3、【问题及意见反馈】
测试游玩中，遇到任何问题或想反馈的内容，请在内测群中提出。如尚未加群的道友，可添加Q群1138175274 ，在群里联系群主、管理进行登记或沟通。或者也可在微博@鬼谷八荒官方 私信反馈情况。

4、【向测试道友的请求】
①本次内测不可直播或放出录屏，请求大家保护处在早期版本的新生鬼谷~
②可以将游戏的内容和体验在大群或其他渠道向其他道友解说分享，但恳请大家温和沟通，嘴下留情~~感谢各位铁子！

再次感谢各位道友对ggbh伸出援手，也再次欢迎大家来到开饭世界！
startGameTipDesc0.en:
Thank you for participating in our alpha test!
Please read the following before proceeding:

1. [Test Period]
12/10/2020 - 12/13/2020 (23:59)
The alpha test will end at midnight on the 14th. All game data and saves will be erased.

2. [Game Content]
Only a small portion of the game will be available during the alpha test:
	① Players can only play for 8 years (in-game time)		② Some spaces on the world map (Swamp, etc.) are locked.
	③ Sect function: Not available expect Sect Tryouts	④ Realm caps at Foundation Early

3. [Feedback]
Please contact us to send your feedback. Thank you!

4. [Requests from Us]
① Please do not stream or upload any game videos during the alpha test.
② Please be supportive if you introduce our game to others.

Thank you for your support!

<size=25>【0.8.1005 版本更新内容】</size>2021年1月19日更新
1.新增了将天材地宝改为必要条件的功能。

startGameTipDesc1.en:
<size=25>[0.8.1005 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 1/19/2021
1. New: Heaven and Earth Treasure can now be set as a necessary requirement.
2. Bug fix: Adventures couldn't be triggered
3. Bug fix: Adventure rewards didn't match players' Realms.
4. Bug fix: Rings' selling prices were too high.
5. Bug fix: Sect Mission errors.
6. Bug fix: Left-click couldn't deal Earth damage sometimes.
7. Bug fix: Spiritlock Circle gave the wrong reward the very first time.
8. Bug fix: Some Ultimate Skills' stat requirements were too high.
9. Bug fix: Manual descriptions
10. Bug fix: Players had to fight themselves during Promotion Duels and couldn't be promoted.
11. Bug fix: Jingwei couldn't be killed.
12. Bug fix: Players had to fight themselves during Promotion Duels and couldn't be promoted.
13. Bug fix: Reputation would drop after killing people in order to complete certain missions.
14. Bug fix: Initiate Disciples couldn't use Portals.
15. Bug fix: Difficulty level and rewards of bounty missions and sect missions.
16. Bug fix: Duration and difficulty level of Mystic Realms.
17. Bug fix: It took too long to learn Manuals in the late stages.
18. Optimization: Item rewards from Ruins
19. Optimization: Difficulty level and rewards of tombs.
20. Optimization: Some descriptions of item sources.
21. Optimization: Some sound effects.
22. New: Some adventure resources.

startGameTipDesc105.ch: 【0.8.3014 版本更新内容】2021年7月30日17时更新 1.新增了更换主界面主题的功能。 2.新增了保存主界面壁纸的功能。 3.新增了制作手机壁纸的功能。 4.新增了2套立绘（男女各一套）。 5.新增了以下奇遇。 　远志游人。 　生死棋局（由玩家沙思羽投稿）。 6.修复了使用水系灵技灵流术时，若太接近目标，则无法造成伤害的问题。 7.修复了拥有逆天改命青帝遗录，在某些副本中触发后仍然被判定为死亡的问题，以及通关副本后无法复活的问题。 8.修复了逆天改命双修大法触发后，显示对方赠送了道具，但实际却没有收到的问题。 9.修复了法宝技能可能会出现不正确的词条的问题。 10.修复了部分器灵的天赋解锁条件（消耗橙色品质的秘籍）不能正确检测到背包中达到要求的秘籍的问题。 11.下调了陨幽谷中使用冥魂之息召唤的酸与难度。 12.修复了陨幽谷中使用冥魂之息召唤酸与后立即切换房间，会导致酸与直接死亡的问题。 13.降低了宗门立场不合格的惩罚（包括灵石、贡献、禁足时间）。 14.修复了奇遇（君愿知）的纪念品书信无法丢弃的问题。 15.修复了奇遇（道心阁）可能产出错误秘籍的问题。 16.优化了部分奇遇的发生条件，使其更加合理。 17.修复了堪舆出的特殊地点可能会与城镇位置重叠的问题。 18.修复了学习秘籍之后，音效没有关闭的问题。 19.修复了部分怪物的技能音效不正确的问题。 20.修复了某些战斗场景的音效音量过低的问题。 21.优化了各仙露的产出说明，使其产出位置更直观。 22.修正了土系绝技震地波的技能描述。 23.修正了心法词条（每有1点拳法资质可使会心提升）中需求资质图标不正确的问题。 24.修复了装备幽凝摘星戒后，会出现错误的效果图标的问题。

startGameTipDesc110.en:
<size=25>[0.8.3019 Patch Notes]</size>Updated on 28 August 2021 at 02:00
1. Added a new side plot to the challenge (Frosty Bingyi).
Added one-click material insertion to the Artifact repair and upgrade interface.
3. Added a new Adventure to the dungeon.
4. Added dialogue for some NPCs.
5. Optimized the Gift AI of NPCs (some NPCs will gift Breakthrough materials and Manuals under certain conditions).
6. Fixed the problem where Tempering Resin cannot be produced while mining and added the Identification Manual to shop stocks in the Town Market.
7. Fixed the problem where first fight in the main plot (Hou Yi Shoots the Suns) in Defeat the Three-legged Crow does not have the Three-legged Crow's HP hidden.
 8. Fixed the problem where the Mission may disappear after fighting the Firebird the second time during the Adventure (Feather of the Golden Crow).
9. Fixed the problem where the Ultimate Skill Lightning Retribution will attack yourself when using the artifact spirit Mengyi's skill.
10. Fixed the problem where the recharge time of the spear Special Skill has anomalies under certain circumstances.
11 Fixed the problem where the game may freeze when using the Special Skill Sinful Flame.
12. Fixed the problem where in Spiritlock Circle and under certain circumstances, giving the Venerable Tortoise Spiritual Fruit will cause the game to flicker.
 13. Fixed the problem where the battle freezes when you enter Chi You through the Love knot.
14. Fixed the problem where under certain conditions, the game freezes after sparring with the NPC in the encounter scene and you are exiting.
15. Fixed the problem where the item drop time and special effects don't match when the boss dies.
16. Fixed the problem where TIPS keep blinking when viewing the details in the Artifact Spirit interface.
17. Fixed the problem where the mount Emerald Gourd's special effects display has anomalies.
18. Fixed the problem where the NPC dialogue bubbles have anomalies in the Auction interface.

startGameTipDesc111.en:
<size=25>[0.8.3020 Patch Notes]</size>Updated on 30 August 2021 at 23:00
Added English language option. If you have played Tale of Immortal in the past and have a profile, the default language setting might be in Chinese. If that's the case, please change the language in Settings: 语言—Change 简体中文 to English (Alpha) and restart the game.
1. Fixed the problem where Rewrite Destiny (Training Partner) leads to the game freezing when activated.
2. Fixed the problem where the Fist type Special Skill Ironbody Fist properties do not trigger (explodes when the Shield Shadow disappears and deals damage and Stun to nearby enemies).
3. Fixed the problem where revenge is still sought after Spirit Artifact Ningshuang's Adventure (Conceal Traces) is triggered.
4. Fixed the problem where under certain circumstances, over 10 items can be gifted to an NPC.
5. Optimized the feedback where gifting multiple items to an NPC results in them only receiving a portion of the items.
6. Fixed the problem where an Adventure is triggered in the dungeon and mismatches appear in the NPC dialogue interface.
7. Fixed the problem where using Artifacts in battle might result in the special effects of the Artifact not disappearing.
8. Fixed the problem where the exit Portal in the Invite scene might not be displayed.
9. Fixed the problem where the text displayed in the dialogue option button might be shrunk.

<size=25>【0.8.4001 版本更新内容】</size>2021年10月22日18时更新
1.新增了宗门大比玩法。
　在华封州、云陌州、暮仙州区域内每隔3年将会举办一次。
　举办时将邀请本区域的各大宗门参赛，参与大比需要消耗1个月时间。
　参赛的宗门将派出宗门内的真传弟子参与大比，长老、大长老及宗主可对参赛弟子进行督战，为弟子在大比中提供帮助。
　大比分为积分赛与擂台赛。
　积分赛时，每个宗门的参赛弟子逐一与其他宗门的弟子进行比试，每轮的胜者会获得积分，最终积分排名靠前的宗门可晋级参加擂台赛。
　擂台赛为已经晋级的宗门的所有参赛弟子自由进行一对一的比试，在擂台赛中每击败一名弟子也可获得积分，最终总积分最多的宗门为本州第一宗，个人积分最多的弟子则为大比魁首。
　大比结束后，将会根据每个宗门及弟子获得的名次发放奖励。
2.新增了资源点争夺玩法。
　在大地图中会随机出现各种资源点，宗门可以派弟子去占领或是掠夺资源点。
　宗门占领资源点后，需要派弟子驻守，即可每个月获得对应的宗门资源。
　宗门也可派弟子去掠夺其他宗门的资源点，直接掠夺一次资源。
3.新增了宗门大战玩法。
　宗主可向本州的其他宗门发起宗门战。
　发起宗门战后将会全宗出动，向目标宗门进行攻击。
　出动时需要携带一定的宗门资源，用于在宗门战中治疗受伤的弟子，使其可以继续参战。
　宗门战分为外部战场、神兽战场与巅峰战场。
　内门弟子与外门弟子在外部战场击破对方宗门的大阵。
　高级弟子则在大阵被击破的时机穿过大阵，进入对方宗门内部，攻击其神兽。
　将对方的神兽击败后，宗主即可进入巅峰战场，与对方的宗主战斗，击败其宗主即可胜利。
　宗门战胜利后，可以选择掠夺或是直接覆灭其宗门。
　掠夺宗门可将对方宗门的资源掠夺给本宗弟子。
　覆灭宗门则可以在其宗门位置上建立自己的宗门分舵，并获得其主修功法与传承（若有）。
4.重做了各区域宗门的分布规则。
　大型宗门的总部会在高级的州，低级的州将会有这些宗门的分舵。
　去往高级区域时，可继续加入同一个宗门。
5.新增了宗门搬迁功能。
　宗主可以建造飞舟，带领本宗弟子前往下一个区域，并建立新的宗门。
6.调整了部分宗门建筑的功能。
　任务大厅：新增了长老及以上的职位可以在任务大厅中分配任务给弟子的功能。
　议事大厅：优化了宗门各项资源的显示与说明，以及宗门日志内容。
　聚宝仙楼：优化了聚宝仙楼中可产出的道具类型（现在有概率产出突破材料、技能修炼材料等）。
　藏经阁：新增了宗主可以藏经阁中修改本宗主修功法的功能（修改后可在下次刷新时生效）。
　灵阁：原来的灵阁，在灵阁中突破，会出现宗门特有的逆天改命可选。
　神兽峰：可与神兽互动，神兽有化灵的功能（消耗2个灵果，可以转化出1个指定属性的灵果）。
7.优化了宗门各项资源的作用。
　宗门领地：领地可提升宗门繁荣度的上限。
　宗门名誉：名誉可决定宗门藏经阁产出的秘籍数量与品质。
　安定度：安定度较高时，可使宗门的繁荣度稳步提升，反之繁荣度则会下降。
　繁荣度：繁荣度决定每月从宗门领地内收取的税收灵石。
　忠诚度：忠诚度决定每月主动离开宗门的记名弟子数量。
　灵石：用于给宗门弟子发放俸禄、扩展领地以及建造飞舟。
　矿材：用于聚宝仙楼中，补充突破灵气、丹炉、技能修炼材料、炼器材料等道具。
　药材：用于聚宝仙楼中，补充天材地宝、丹药、灵果、药材等道具。
8.新增了宗门的宗旨、门规与特质。
　门规为本宗门弟子不可做的行为，若违反门规，则会受到宗门的惩罚。
　特质为本宗门的特殊效果。
9.调整了宗门的职位框架、晋升方式以及各职位的人数与权利。
　宗主：开放了玩家可以晋升为宗主的功能，宗主拥有调整宗门弟子职位、发动宗门战、发动资源战、设置宗门主修功法、修改宗门名字、门规等权利。
　大长老：大长老拥有调整其属下弟子职位、发动资源战、派遣弟子任务的权利。
　长老：长老拥有调整其属下弟子职位、派遣弟子任务的权利。
　真传弟子：拥有参与宗门大比的资格。
10.新增了各个职位的宗门任务。
　职位越高，可以领取难度越高的任务，获得的奖励也越高。
　旧存档在进入游戏后，需要运转一个月后才会有新的任务出现。
11.新增了宗门专属的逆天改命。
　每个宗门都有一个特有的逆天改命，只有本宗的弟子可获得。
12.新增了宗门传承。
　每个宗门的总部都会有一个传承，新晋升的宗主通过传承的考验后，即可获得该传承。
13.新增了天骄NPC。
　天骄NPC拥有更强的属性与技能。
　天骄NPC会更难提升亲密度。
　天骄NPC拥有道心，拥有道心后突破即可获得逆天改命。
　新增了天骄NPC的对话内容。
14.新增了器灵语音。
15.新增了动态立绘功能。
16.新增了NPC的烦恼功能。
17.新增了部分NPC的对话文本。

<size=25>[0.8.4001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated on 22 October 2021 at 18:00
**Due to time constraints, some of the English text has not been translated yet. We will update the English text as soon as possible.
1. The Sect Competition is now available.
　The Sect Competition will be held once every 3 years in the Huafeng, Yunmao and Muxian continents.
　All sects in the region will be invited to participate in the competition, which will take 1 month to complete.
　The competing Sects will send their True Disciples to participate in the competition. The Elders, Grand Elders and Sect Leaders will supervise the competing Disciples and help them in the competition.
　The Sect Competition is divided into a points competition and a ring competition.
　In the points competition, each disciple competes one by one against the disciples from other sects, with the winner of each round gaining points.
　In the Tournament, all participating disciples of the sect that have already advanced will compete in a one-on-one match.
　At the end of the Sect Competition, rewards will be given to each sect and disciple according to their ranking.
2. Added resource spot competition.
　Various resource spot will appear randomly on the map and sects can send their disciples to occupy or plunder them.
　Once a sect has occupied a resource spot, they will need to send their disciples to guard it and receive the corresponding sect resources every month.
　Sects can also send their disciples to plunder other clan's resource points to directly plunder resources once.
3. Added Sect War 
　The sect leader can start a sect war with other sects in his state.
　After starting a sect war, the whole sect will be mobilised to attack the target sect.
　You will need to bring a certain amount of sect resources with you to heal your injured disciples during the sect war so that they can continue to fight.
　The sect war are divided into external battles, divine beast battles and summit battles.
　Inner disciples and outer disciples break down the opposing sect's battlefield in the external battlefield.
　The senior disciples will go through the array when it is broken and enter the opponent's sect to attack the  legendary beast.
　Once the legendary beast has been defeated, the sect leader can enter the battlefield and fight the enemy sect leader to win.
　Once the sect has won the war, the victor can choose to plunder or destroy the defeated sect.
　Plundering a clan allows you to plunder the resources of the other clan for your own disciples.
　If you destroy a sect, you can create your own sect rudder in the sect's place and gain access to its main martial and legacy (if any).
4. Redone of the distribution rules for regional sects
　Large sects will have their headquarters in the higher continents and the lower continents will have their subsection.
　You can continue to join the same sect when you go to a higher level region.
5. Added sect relocation function
　The sect leader can build a flying boat to lead his sect's disciples to the next region and establish a new sect.
6. Adjusted the functions of some sect buildings.
　Mission Hall:A new function has been added for disciples in the position of Elder and above to be able to assign tasks to other disciples in the Task Hall.
　Council Hall: optimise the display and description of the sect's resources and the content of the sect log.
　Treasure Pavilion:  the types of items that can be produced in the Treasure Pavilion have been optimised (they now have a probability of producing breakthrough materials, skill materials, etc.).
　Manual Library: now allows thesect leader to modify the sect's main techniques (the modification will take effect on the next refresh).
　Spirit Pavilion: the original Cultivation Chamber, breakthrough in the Spirit Pavilion, will appear the sect's unique optional Destiny.
　Legendary Beast Peak: You can interact with the legendary beast, which has the function of transforming into a spirit (consume 2  Spiritual Fruit to transform into 1  Spiritual Fruit with specified attributes).
7. Optimised the role of various resources of the sect.
　Sect's territory: The territory can raise the maximum prosperity of the sect.
　Sect's reputation: reputation determines the quantity and quality of Manuals produced in the Sect's Manual Library.
　Stability: A high level of stability will steadily increase the prosperity of the sect, while the opposite will decrease it.
　Prosperity: Prosperity determines the amount of tax spirit stones collected from the sect's territory each month.
　Loyalty: Loyalty determines the number of registered disciples who leave the sect each month.
　Spirit Stones: These are used to pay Wage to sect members, to expand the territory and to build Flying boats.
　Ore: Used in the Treasure Pavilion to replenish Qi, Furnace, skill training materials, forging material and other items.
　Herb: Used in the Treasure Pavilion to replenish Heaven and Earth Treasure, Elixirs, sprit fruits and herbs.
8. The Sect Purpose, Sect Rules and Traits have been added.
　The Sect Rules are the rules of the sect that disciples are not allowed to do, and if they violate them, they will be punished by the sect.
　Traits are special effects of the sect.
9. Adjusted sect's position framework, promotion methods and the number and power of each position.
　Sect leader: player now can promote to leader. Sect leader has the right to adjust the positions of the disciples of the sect, to launch sect wars, resource spot competition, set the sect's main techniques, and modify the sect's name and rules.
　Grand Elder: The Grand Elder has the right to adjust the positions of the disciples under him, to wage resource wars and to dispatch disciples on missions.
　Elders: Elders have the right to adjust the positions of their subordinate disciples and dispatch disciples on missions.
　True disciples: they are eligible to participate in the sect competition.
10. Added the sect mission for each position.
　The higher the position, the more difficult the mission and the higher the reward.
11. Added new sect-exclusive Destiny
　Each sect has a unique Destiny, which can only be obtained by disciples of the sect.
12. Added new sect legacy
　Each sect has a legacy at its headquarters, which can be obtained by newly promoted sect leader once they have passed the legacy test.
13. Added new Heaven Chosen NPC
　The Heaven Chosen NPCs have stronger Stats Info and skills.
　Heaven Chosen NPCs will be harder to raise in affinity.
　The Heaven Chosen NPC has a Heart of a Taoist, after a breakthrough was achieved by having a Heart of a Taoist, they can get Ultimate Skills.
　14.New dialogue content for the Heaven Chosen NPCs has been added.
15. Added dynamic drawing function.
16. Added the function of NPC's worry
17. Added dialogue text for some NPCs.

startGameTipDesc144.en:
<size=25>[0.8.4015 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 21:00 on October 29, 2021
1. Fixed the problem that in some cases, you may become an Initiate of sect in the previous continent.
2. Fixed the problem that when joining a sect in some cases, even if there is no current sect, it will prompt that there is already a sect and cannot be joined.
3. Fixed the problem that sect loyalty was always 0 and could not be increased.
4. Fixed the problem that the button to raise loyalty in the sect council hall interface is not responsive when clicked.
5. Fixed the problem that when the battle in the peak battlefield ends too quickly in the sect war, it may lead to jamming.
6. Fixed the problem that the sect leader might fly into the air when using the body technique during the sect war.
7. Fixed the problem that the position of the props equipped in the prop bar may be confused in the sect war.
8. Optimized the problem that the stamina bar of the  legendary beast in the sect war may not be displayed accurately.
9. Added the function that the sect leader can send disciples to participate in the sect war of the branch on his own behalf.
10. Fixed the problem that the player's custom branch name was inherited when the sect moved.
11. Fixed the problem that the CD of skills may become shorter and shorter after multiple resurrections in the sect war.
12. Optimized the awards and process of the defending side award conference of the sect war.
13. Optimized the text content of the award ceremony of the sect war.
14. Added the content of the log of the sect war.
15. Fixed the problem that the clan lost directly when the number of clan disciples was insufficient in the sect competition.
16. Fixed the problem that the resting non-seriously injured disciples did not regain their strength before entering the ring after the sect Challenge Match.
17. Optimized the problem that when a high position character attacks a low position disciple in the sect will also be punished by the little sister.
18. Fixed the problem that when the temporary backpack is full, clicking skip this month will change the date first, resulting in no time to deal with the temporary backpack.
19. Fixed the problem that when opening a treasure chest, the backpack interface is not refreshed in time.
20. Optimized the AI of NPC (will actively use the treasure chest now).
21. Fixed the problem that NPCs with last breath may actively interact with players.
22. Optimized the problem that NPCs will appear incorrectly annoyed.
23. Optimized the problem that NPC's problem task guide target is incorrect.
24. Fixed the problem that the quest still exists after the NPC's troubles are solved.
25. Optimized the problem that when a disciple of the same sect fights in the territory, a disciple of the same sect will also help to participate in the battle.
26. Added the sect log when the clan position is transferred.
27. Fixed the problem that the boar nest appearing in the invitation scene would still exist in the scene after the battle was over and continue to attack.
28. Fixed an issue where the boar nest could be moved by certain skills, causing it to be dragged out of the battle scene.
29. Fixed the problem that the Dangkang summoned by the boar nest would not catch people under certain circumstances.
30. Optimized the quality names of some interest props.
31. Optimized the performance of the blood bar of the BOSS (shield display has been added).
32. Fixed the dialogue of some NPCs.

<size=25>[0.8.4016 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 21:00 on November 1, 2021
1. Fixed the problem that disciples performing sect missions would incorrectly lead to death under certain circumstances.
2. Optimized the AI of NPCs in the sect.
    When there are too many people in the sect, NPCs will feel hopeless to be promoted and cause to leave the sect.
    NPCs may also leave the sect when the loyalty is too low.
    NPCs who have a kinship with the sect leader will not leave the sect easily.
    After leaving the sect, NPCs will no longer rejoin the same sect in the short term.
3. Fixed the problem that the main quest for breaking through the realm could not be completed.
4. Fixed the problem that NPCs with last breath would also participate in the auction.
5. Fixed the problem that Turtle of  Spiritlock Circle could get rewards even without passing in some cases.
6. Fixed the problem that NPCs did not move to the battle position in the big map when they helped the disciples of the same sect to fight.
7. Added the function of marking the disciple's position in the sect position screen.
8. Fixed the problem that when sending disciples to defend a sect battle, the plot dialogue appeared incorrectly after the battle.
9. Fixed the problem that when a sect is declared war by more than one sect at the same time, it leads to stuck or infinite plots.
10. Optimized the protection period of the Sect Array and its prompt instructions.
11. Optimized the pre-war plot dialogue of the sect war.
12. Optimized the strategy interface in the council hall.
13. Fixed the problem that the terrain around the sect on the big map did not change after changing the sect's position.
14. Fixed the problem that the log in the clan mission hall interface was not displayed correctly.
15. Added a new monthly refreshing prompt when the opening conditions of the sect competition are not met.
16. Fixed the problem that the defeated party's blood is not seriously wounded when the win/loss animation is played after the battle of the points race.
17. Fixed the problem that the AI may use props within a short period of time after the end of the sect competition battle.
18. Optimized the AI of the NPC leader assigning disciples to the field during the sect competition points race.
19. Fixed the problem that under certain circumstances, the attributes of the participants of the sect competition may appear abnormal.
20. Fixed the problem that some NPCs may be repeatedly killed in battle.
21. Optimized the text of the description of the main cultivation function cap in the Manual Library.

startGameTipDesc147.en:
<size=25>[0.8.4018 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 5 November 2021 at 03:00
1. Added the function of Taoist Mind Durability.
2. Added the option to humiliate NPCs after defeating them (can lower the opponent's Taoist Mind Durability).
3. Fixed the problem that the realm requirement for joining a sect was incorrect after a sect move.
4. Fixed the problem where the contribution of a sect would be cleared when joining a sect with a sect pass.
5. Fixed a problem where the sect's territory could cross regions when expanding.
6. Fixed the problem where NPCs would not be promoted to become sect leaders.
7. Optimised the AI of NPCs picking the Destiny when breaking through.
8. Fixed the problem where NPCs would repeatedly express the same annoyance to players.
9. Adjusted the rewards of some sect quests.
10. Fixed the problem that the number of resources captured during sect war looting was always 0.
11. Optimised the text of the log where the resources looted in a sect battle were actually 0 (the looted sect no longer had resources to loot).
12. Fixed the problem that when looting resources in a sect battle, the reward given to disciples did not consume resources.
13. Optimised the plot dialogue when a friendly sect comes to support in a sect battle.
14. Optimised the close button on the send disciple agent to participate in the sect battle.
15. Optimised the position of all disciples in the sect to return to their sect after the sect war.
16. Optimised the issue where a character with Last Breath may appear in some episodes of the sect battle.
17. Fixed the issue where the resource limit on the Select Resources screen was incorrectly displayed when a sect was declared war at a branch.
18. Optimised the time interval between a sect's headquarters or remnant disciples counter-attacking after a sect has been destroyed.
19. Fixed an issue where NPCs and players might have the same name during sect war.
20. Fixed the problem that the death of both the legendary beast and the defending sect master during the sect war may cause the defending sect master to not appear in the summit battle.
21. Optimised the behaviour of NPCs on flying boats during sect war.
22. Optimised the issue that NPCs may walk outside the flying boat during the award ceremony of the sect war.
23. Optimised some of the plot dialogues of the sect battle.
24. Optimised the hint of successful sect war declaration.
25. Optimised the log text of sect wars.
26. Optimised the problem that in some cases, the disciples who came back to report after the sect war were enemy disciples.
27. Fixed the issue that when sending a disciple on a looting mission, the effect of a disciple receiving a serious injury was not applied correctly.
28. Fixed the issue where the same disciple could be sent to perform a resource point looting mission repeatedly within a month.
29. Fixed the issue where it was possible to loot the resource points of your own sect.
30. Fixed the issue where stamina could be 0 after returning to the large map at the end of a resource battle.
31. Fixed the issue where clicking on an occupied resource point might be invalid under certain circumstances.
32. Optimised the plot of sending disciples on resource point looting missions.
33. Fixed the issue where the ring master's use of elixirs might have no effect during the sect tournament.
34. Fixed the problem that the ring master's stamina was not updated in the preparation screen of the sect tournament.
35. Added a new scenario for the sect competition in Muxian.
36. Fixed the issue where characters might drift after the sect Tournament.
37. Fixed the issue where players could not supervise some of the disciples in the Tournament when they were leading the sect as the Grand Elder of the branch.
38. Optimized the operation of assigning disciples in the sect Grand Tournament (you can pre-select the next disciple to be assigned to the stage).
39. Optimised the layout of the sect competition interface.

startGameTipDesc152.en:

36. Optimized the dialogue display style of NPCs in the resource war.

startGameTipDesc154.ch: 【0.8.4025 版本更新内容】2021年11月30日22时更新 1.新增了一个特殊宗门御龙山庄（需要创建新档并且选择先天气运龙祖灵息才能生成）。 2.新增了道号功能。 3.新增了精卫的动态效果。 4.洪荒模式下的道具掉落改为了双倍掉落。 5.洪荒模式下突破时最多可以出现9个逆天改命选项。 6.提升了宗门任务的贡献奖励。 7.修复了当玩家成为宗主后，任务大厅刷出某些任务的概率会大幅变低的问题。 8.优化了部分宗门任务刷新的位置与宗门距离过远的问题。 9.调整了部分宗门任务奇遇的产出。 10.修复了宗门繁荣度上限无法正常提升的问题。 11.修复了枪系绝技的词条（有概率回复1点充能）回复的充能点数不正确的问题。 12.修复了宗门的聚宝仙楼在消耗宗门药材及矿材后，产出的材料不正确的问题。 13.修复了在某些情况下，游戏会卡在存档升级界面的问题。 14.修复了使用雷系功法时可能会出现偶尔卡顿的问题。 15.修复了在某些情况下发起宗门战时，己方宗门的分舵会支援敌方宗门的问题。 16.修复了内门小比时，参赛的NPC与真传弟子战斗时的结果不正确的问题。 17.修复了宗门战的日志可能会记录到敌方宗门内的问题。 18.修复了宗门的分舵被灭宗后，其总部可能会仍然向该分舵调派人员的问题。 19.修复了先天气运（神匠门徒）获得的法宝没有融合器灵的问题。 20.修复了在战斗中有多个爆灵湖叠在同一个地方时，其中一个爆灵湖消失可能会导致其它爆灵湖的效果也消失的问题。 21.修复了切磋时输了可能会触发器灵对话的问题。 22.修复了在某些副本中救助NPC时，可以重复给予丹药，获得正道值奖励。 23.修复了在某些情况下搬迁宗门会导致游戏卡死的问题。 24.修复了宗门推荐信在入宗小比时没有效果的问题。 25.修复了在某些情况下，宗门搬迁时选择资源界面显示不正确问题。 26.修复了首次进入藏经阁及聚宝仙楼触发小师妹的对话后，没有获得奖励的问题。 27.修复了在宗门大比开启时，选择拒绝参赛可能仍然会进入到宗门大比的问题。 28.修复了在剧情中产出道具时，奖励界面会被剧情对话遮挡住的问题。 29.优化了逆天改命（水力四射）的特效。 30.优化了宗门神兽的化灵功能的引导剧情。 31.优化了部分宗门日志文本。
startGameTipDesc154.en: [0.8.4025 Patch Notes] Updated at 22:00 on November 30, 2021 1. Added a part of English text (the translated text is the first version of the translation, and will be adjusted and corrected in future updates to make it more uniform and relevant to express the original meaning). Up to version 0.8.4025, 80% of Sect·Heaven Chosen(updated on October 22, 2021) text translation has been added to the game. The text of the content generated by this new version(0.8.4025) is still being translated. 2. Added a new special sect Dragon Mountain Hamlet (need to create a new file and select the Destiny(Nature) Elder Dragon Aura to generate it). 3. Added a new Taoist Title function. 4. Added the dynamic effect of Jingwei. 5. Prop drops in Chaos mode have been changed to double drops. 6. Up to 9 Destiny options can appear when breaking through in Chaos mode. 7. Improved the contribution rewards of sect missions. 8. Fixed the problem that the probability of certain quests in the Mission Hall would become significantly lower when the player became the sect leader. 9. Optimized the problem that some of the sect missions were refreshed at locations too far away from the sect. 10. Adjusted the output of some sect adventures missions. 11. Fixed the problem that in some cases, the game will be stuck in the archive upgrade interface. 12. Fixed the problem that the game may occasionally lag when using Lightning Manual. 13. Fixed the problem that the branch of your own sect would support the enemy sect when launching a sect war under certain circumstances. 14. Fixed the problem that the results of the battle between the participating NPCs and true disciples were incorrect during the Promotion Duel (Disciple). 15. Fixed the problem that the logs of sect war might be recorded in the enemy sect. 16. Fixed the problem that after a sect's branch was destroyed, its headquarters might still transfer personnel to that branch. 17. Fixed the problem that magic treasures obtained by Destiny(Nature) (Forging Apprentice) did not fuse with the Artifact Spirit. 18. Fixed the problem that when multiple Energy Pond is stacked in the same place in a battle, the disappearance of one of the Energy Pond may cause the effects of the others to disappear as well. 19. Fixed the problem that losing a sparring match may trigger the Artifact Spirit dialogue. 20. Fixed the problem that when rescuing NPCs in certain Dungeon, you can repeatedly give elixirs to get Righteous Points. 21. Fixed the problem that relocating the sect would cause the game to get stuck under certain circumstances. 22. Fixed the problem that the sect recommendation letter had no effect when entering the Sect Duel. 23. Fixed the problem of incorrect display of the resource selection screen when relocating sects under certain circumstances. 24. Fixed the problem that the first time you enter the Manual Library and the treasure Pavilion after triggering the dialogue of the Junior, the player does not get the reward. 25. Optimized the text of the monthly refreshing when unable to participate in the sect competition. 26. Fixed the problem that when the sect competition was launched, choosing to refuse to participate may still lead to the competition. 27. Fixed the problem that the reward screen would be blocked by the plot dialogue when the items were produced in the plot. 28. Optimized the special effects of Rewrite Destiny (Water Burst). 29. Optimized the guidance plot of the Sect beast's Spirit Transformation function. 30. Optimized the text of some sect logs.

<size=25>[0.8.1021 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 10 PM, 1/30/2021
1. Optimization: Adjusted the requirements for casting Divine Pulse Finger and Flower Faerie Queen.
2. Optimization: Adjusted the requirements for casting some Ultimate Skills.
3. Bug fix: Units summoned by players would block their projectiles.
4. New: Added the [Inventory] button on the world map.
5. New: Added a function that allows players to continue dialogue by pressing the Space Bar.
6. Optimization: Adjusted the messages in the monthly summary regarding special bosses.
7. Bug fix: Sect Portals couldn't be used even after players had reached the Affinity requirement.
8. Bug fix: Closing the page after making a bid during auctions would prevent NPCs from bidding.
9. Bug fix: NPCs wouldn't do anything when their Mood was low.
10. Optimization: NPCs will do things to remove their negative Destinies.
11. Optimization: Increased the spawn probabilities of Land of Beyond and Land of No Return.
12. Bug fix: Fire Flare didn't have any cooldown.
13. Optimization: Skill affix.
14. Optimization: Adjusted the available options during the main story in Yun Mo.
15. Bug fix: Wrong bounty mission rewards when players helped NPCs explore Monster Lairs.
16. Bug fix: Nuwa couldn't spawn in the main mission, which caused players to be stuck in the game.
17. Bug fix: Entering the cave where Jagu was when Vitality was below 50% would freeze the game.
18. Bug fix: 2 Jagus would appear after his transformation.
19. Bug fix: Reputation would be shown as dropped in the monthly summary after players killed people to complete sect missions.
20. Bug fix: Tips of some Manuals would appear on the screen all the time.
21. Bug fix: [New] would remain on the Mail interface and Mission interface.
22. Bug fix: The game would freeze if Grounded and Sect Tryouts occurred in the same month.
23. Bug fix: The page couldn't be closed after Sect Tryouts were over.
24. Bug fix: Breakthrough errors.
25. Bug fix: Units summoned by some skills could prevent dungeon monsters from spawning.
26. Bug fix: Game resolution would be reset to default after players returned to the Main Menu.
27. Bug fix: Wrong description of Pickpocket.
28. Optimization: Descriptions of some Destinies.
29. Bug fix: Sect Tryout notifications would appear in the monthly summary even if they didn't occur.
30. Bug fix: Wrong requirements for unlocking some achievements.
31. Bug fix: Some activities (Spar, Debate, Dual Cultivation, etc.) were not counted in achievements.

startGameTipDesc175.en:
<size=25>[0.8.5001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 21:00 on January 17, 2022
1. Unlocked the Artifact (Eye of Providence) with the following functions.
　Added 1 grid of large map view.
　There is a probability to view more items when viewing NPC backpack.
　When fighting with the Mythical Beast, there is a probability to learn the skills they cast.
　When you take a fatal injury in battle, you can rewind the time to the state before you were seriously injured and get out of the battle.
2. The following Adventures have been added.  
　 Where the Wind Blows (can be triggered after completing the main quest Suiren Kindles the First Flame).
3. Added dynamic expressions for NPC dialogue.
4. Optimized some of the Adventures of Elder Dragon Aura.
5. Optimized the confirmation method of Adventures, dialogues, and monthly refreshing (use WASD and space to select and confirm).
6. Optimized the purchase interface of Treasure Pavilion.
7. Optimized the display of the power bar when casting the power accumulation skill.
8. Fixed the problem that NPCs may come to ask for guidance during the Qi refining period.
9. Added the classification function of gift items.
10. Added the function of filtering buildings on the small map.
11. Optimized the problem of random drawing when switching gender in the character creation interface.
12. Fixed the problem of incorrect coercion of the Taoist Title.
13. Fixed the problem of changing Martial stuck when challenging the Taoist Title.
14. Fixed the problem that the items (Winning Lot) could not be consumed normally.
15. Added the function of adjusting the authority of the Grand Elder or Elder to dispatch the population.
16. Fixed the problem that after retreating from the sect, there may still be NPCs from the original sect to ask about sect affairs.
17. Fixed the problem of Intelligent (Destiny Nature), sometimes reducing the mood cap does not match the description (previously it was reducing the percentage, while the description was reducing the fixed value).
18. Optimized the Artifact Spirit Jiang Lingge's talent description (Energy can improve ATK ) incomplete problem (the effect did not change, supplemented the missing description).
19. Fixed the problem that some attack ballistics may cause multiple damage.
20. Fixed the issue that NPCs would also show the charged bar when using the charged skill.
21. Fixed the problem that the character display at the top of the interface might be lost after receiving or submitting quests in sects and towns.
22. Fixed the problem that when the BOSS used the  Water Motion Skills in some dungeons, it would cause the dungeon to get stuck and not settle normally.
23. Fixed the problem that when learning the manual, the experience progress showed 100% but the skill was not actually learned.
24. Added the volume adjustment setting of the Artifact Spirit voice.
25. Optimized the function of modifying keys and added support for mouse side keys.
26. Optimized the Sect Tactics interface.

2.调整了昊天眼的解锁条件（除任意难度下突破至金丹境外，已解锁洪荒模式后也可开局选择昊天眼）。
3.优化了妖兽（蛊雕）的昊天眼技能领悟的规则（降低了其击破弱点所需的伤害）。

startGameTipDesc177.en:
<size=25>[0.8.5003 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 18:00 on January 18, 2022
1. Fixed the problem that teach Wayborne Seed may cause the game to get stuck under certain circumstances.
2. Adjusted the unlocking conditions of Eye of Providence (except for the breakthrough to Golden Core Realm under any difficulty, you can also choose Eye of Providence after you have unlocked the chaos mode).
3. Optimized the rules for compelling the Eye of Providence skill of the monsters (Gudiao) (reduced the damage required to break its weakness).
4. Optimized the problem that after breaking away from the battle through the Eye of Providence, it may teleport to an incorrect location.
5. Fixed the problem that the description text of some Eye of Providence skills was incorrect.
6. Fixed the problem that the map will still show all the building icons when opened again after all the filter items are closed.
7. Optimized part of the plot of the Adventures (Where the Wind Blows).

startGameTipDesc187.en:
<size=25>[0.8.5013 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 17:00 on February 25, 2022
1. Added three new Adventures (Palm Mountain, Sword Shrine, and Worn Temple).
2. Optimized the automatic pathfinding until the end, will not automatically enter the town and sect and other buildings.
3. Optimized the AI of NPC cultivation skills.
4. Optimized the display of NPC's Taoist Title challenge button.
5. Optimized some dialogue texts of NPCs.
6. Fixed the problem that a large number of dungeons may be refreshed around towns and sects under certain circumstances.
7. Optimized the problem that the player's sect frequently declared war on powerful sects when the battle power was too low.
8. Added [Fill in] button to the interface of auction house consignment items, you can fill in the reference reserve price after clicking it.
9. Fixed the problem that when fighting with Nether Nibbling Ape with Rewrite Destiny (Warlord's Phantom), the damage would still be taken within the shield range.
10. Fixed the problem that multiple heel dragons will appear after resurrecting in some dungeons when you have the Rewrite Destiny (Following Dragon).
11. Fixed the problem that the red value of the word of Secret Manual(Spear Special Skill) (with Destruction to enhance charging speed) was weaker than the orange value.
12. Fixed the issue that in some cases, when fighting with fake Sage Tianbao, the battle may not end properly.
13. Fixed the problem that when the auction house requests NPCs to give up bidding for items at auctions, they can give the plot or quest props to each other.
14 Fixed the problem that some plot events may not be triggered properly when using Flying Mount to move in Taihang Mountain under certain circumstances.
15. Added some sect logs.
16. Replaced the Chinese New Year themed decorations in towns and clans back to the normal version.
17. Replace the background music of the Chinese New Year theme back to the normal version.

startGameTipDesc211.en:
<size=25>[Internal Test Version 062102 Patch Notes]</size> Update time: 12 AM, 6/22/2022
<size=20>This version is for test uses, and there may be some unexpected problems in it. Besides, many contents in this version may be subject to future amendments. If you find any glitch that may impact your gaming experience, please let us know, and we will fix it ASAP. We are also looking forward to your advices and suggestions, thanks for your support!
<r>The path of save files in this version is different from the path applied in official versions. Upon entering the test version for the first time, save files in official versions would be automatically copied to:
C:\Users\(username)\AppData\LocalLow\guigugame\guigubahuang\SteamApotheosis\CacheData</r></size>
1. Reduced the true form HP in G1, G2 and G3 Nether Demons.
2. Reduced the HP and skill damage of Jiuying, a Boss encountered in Main Missions.
3. Reduced the HP and skill damage of Bloodthirst Sparrow.
4. New: Added a guide to offer sacrifice when finding the first Immortal Shrine.
5. Bug fix: Related stories cannot be trigged in some Immortal Shrines.
6. Optimization: The display of Heavenly Arts. Now the collection progress of them can be found in the Heavenly Arts interface.
7. New: Added a dungeon mechanism. Now after the player picked up Mind Spirits in the Mind Sea in the dungeons of Nether Seeds, they would gain a Vitality recovery and increase their ATK for a short time.
8. Bug fix: Game freeze upon opening some interfaces in the Mod Editor.
9. Bug fix: Arrays in the Transcendent Breakthrough dungeon would occasionally move.
10. Bug fix: Display glitches found in some effects when using the Power of Law to enter the Stage II in the Transcendent Breakthrough dungeon.
11. Bug fix: Game freeze after becoming the Master of the Cultivator’s Alliance.
12. Bug fix: Display error on stats shown in the interface of choosing a Nether Feather to enhance when breaking through minor realms in Reborn.
13. Bug fix: Abnormal damage from Heavenly Arts.
14. Bug fix: Data loss of some buildings (Market, Mission Hall, Auction House, etc.) after the moving of the Cultivator’s Alliance.
15. Adjustment: The location of Mirage in the Transcendent Breakthrough mission "Look for Mirage Qi Orb".
16. New: Icons for new skills of Eye of Providence are added.
17. Optimization: The name and skill description for Immortal Chickens; also added icons for their skills.
18. Adjustment: Stats of different kinds of fighting chicken; also optimized the cast chance of triggerable skills, and the accumulation rate of Immortal Chicken’s Ultimate Skill slot.
19. New: Added combat animation for some Immortal Chickens; also optimized the UI when sending Chickens into fight.
20. Bug fix: Abnormal attack frequency of Immortal Chickens under certain circumstances.
21. Bug fix: Occasional game freeze during chicken fighting.
22. New: A set of Mind Skills for Wood sets.
23. Adjustment: Super Armor effect of all Bosses in Chi You. Now when a Boss’s accumulated time under control reaches 20s, it will gain a Super Armor for 20s.
24. Bug fix: Buying items in Treasure Pavilion of the Sect would cost Contribution after the player became a Sect Leader.
25. Bug fix: The mission "Yuan'er's Request for Help" could be accepted after the completion of Main Missions.
26. New: Added the item drop from the Main Mission "Xingtian Slayer"
27. Optimization: Some dungeon scenes when fighting bosses in Chi You.

startGameTipDesc218.en:
<size=25>[0.8.6001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 22:00 on June 29, 2022
Hello Cultivators, the Reborn and Transcendent version is now officially released! At this stage, only 70% of the text content in the new version has been localized, and it will take approximately 2 weeks for the rest of the text to be fully translated. Of course, we understand that some cultivators who can't wait to experience the new version and intend to use Google Translator on their own, we still suggest that players wait for a few weeks until the English localization is fully completed to maximize your gaming experience~
1. Opened the outer area of Chi You and Tian Yuan Mountain.
2. Opened the Reborn Realm and the Transcendent Realm.
3. Added the function of Nether Feather  (available after breaking through the Reborn Realm).
4. Added new Heavenly Art (available after breaking through the Transcendent Realm).
5. Added the plot and challenge of Shrine, where you can get part of Heavenly Art.
6. Added the Shattered Altar challenge (you can get part of Heavenly Art and props for Rewrite Destiny).
7. Added 33 sets of Traditional Mind Skills.
8. Added the main plot: Xingtian Slayer main story.
9. Added the function of Cultivator Alliance.
10. Added the Wave of Monsters.
11. Added the tavern request of Hua Feng (you can get the breakthrough material or manuals after completion).
12. Added BOSS (Xuan bird, Vermilion Bird, Phoenix, Kun Peng, Roc, Golden Roc, Miemeng, Firefly, Candlelight, Peacock, Blue Bird, Nether Beast, Water God Xuanming, Wood God Goumang, Earth God Houtu, Ferocious Beast, Taotie, Jiuying, Xingtian, Demon, etc.
13. New NPCs of Demon.
14. Added the new Taoist Title.
15. Added new Rewrite Destiny for the new realm(Ghost Slash, Lethal Dance, Win-win, Northland Frost, Mirage Miasma, Fire Star, Conflagration, Universe on Palm).
16. Added a variety of NPC interactive plots (after triggering such a plot in, the NPC will have a unique tie to the player, and this NPC in interaction with the player, will be based on the player's choice and affect its subsequent behavior patterns).
17. Cockfight Chicken is being optimized and is not yet open.
18. Optimized the function of the Bagua Jade.
　Players can give half of the Bagua Jade to NPCs, which can be summoned into the battle to fight together.
　When an NPC with half of a double fish pendant is on the verge of death or Last Breath, players can use the Bagua Jade to revive the NPC (requires 1 point of energy).
19. Added some new BOSS skills of Eye of Providence.
20. Optimized the breakthrough experience in the Qi Condensation and Origin Spirit (new entrusted tasks have been added in the taverns of various towns in Huafeng, and completing the delegated tasks may lead to breakthrough materials and advanced manuals, etc.).
21. Optimized some AI behaviors of NPCs.
22. Optimized the AI of some BOSSes in Chaos mode.
23. Optimized the performance of Motion Skill after the Reborn Realm.
24. Optimized the numerical experience of learning manuals and skill levels.
25. Fixed the problem of incorrect values of some mind skills and affixes in Reborn Realm and the Transcendent Realm.

11. Bug fix: High-Realm players would get stuck on the results page after winning Sect Tryouts in low-Realm areas.

startGameTipDesc232.ch:

startGameTipDesc232.en:
<size=25>[0.8.6015 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 10:00 on July 22, 2022
1. Increased the player's mind skill capacity, now the capacity is twice as large as the original.
2. Added a new skill filtering function in the player's skill interface.
3. Fixed the problem that the effect of increasing the maximum stacking layer of BUFFs of martial skills and spiritual skills sometimes could not take effect correctly due to the difference between martial skills, spiritual skills and mind skill realm.
4. Adjusted the word effect of Ironbody Fist (after adjustment, the rotation speed of Shield Shadow is increased by 80% at maximum.)

6. Added the ability to reload the archive directly in the ESC menu.
7. Increased the collision volume of the collision of the Mind Spirits (blue ball moving in elliptical trajectory) in the dungeon of the Nether Seed  of the Reborn Breakthrough.
8. Fixed the problem that the position of the lightning dragon in some cases will instantly drift in the dungeon of the Lightning Retribution, and appropriately extended the time of the Primeval Thunder hovering and flying on the edge of the cliff.
9. Added the rings sold by the cultivators alliance in Chi You and the rings dropped from the Fallen Valley (obtained by defeating Suanyu).
10. Fixed the problem that there is no drop preview in the Fallen Valley in the Chi You.
11. Fixed the problem that the skill of Artifact (Netherworld Blood Seal) (triggering Qi explosion when friendly units in range are damaged) does not work on units with shields.
12. Fixed the problem that the skills of some artifact spirits could not be activated normally in some dungeons.
13. Fixed the problem that the skill value of  artifact spirits (Zhu Yaoyue, Green Scale, Blade Tail, Blood Eye) did not follow the realm of artifact .
14. Fixed the description text of the normal skill of the artifact spirits (Blade Tail) (stated that the effect is not stackable).
15. Removed the abnormal damage skill of Nether Demon (Abyssal Roar).
16. Optimized the output props of the Tao Realm (now the Tao Realm will also produce Spiritual Fruit and feats with corresponding attributes, and increase the output of comprehension materials).
17. Optimized the refreshing consumption rules of the Tao Realm, now each room will provide 3 free refreshing opportunities.
18. Fixed the problem that in some cases the gun stance would get stuck when using the gun stance in the broken altar copy.
19. Fixed the problem that entering the Wave of Monsters will get stuck under certain circumstances.

22. Fixed the problem that the Qi explosion will cause fatal damage when the Lizhu transforms.

24. Fixed the problem that the NPCs added by the MOD do not take effect after the heavenly qi.
25. Fixed the problem that the material for Crafting Guqin in the Shrine can be taken repeatedly after the end of the task.
26. Optimized the text of branch disciples talking about the sect.
27. Optimized the height of the viewpoint in the dungeon of the shrine.
28. Optimized the operation of upgrading skill, now you can directly cultivate to the end of the month.
29. Optimized the performance of upgrading skill, now you can skip the animation of comprehension by pressing the space bar.
30. Fixed the problem that the monsters in some scenes of the Huafeng Tavern Commissioned Mission would be refreshed outside the map.
31. Optimized the copy difficulty and incorrect output of Huafeng Tavern's Commissioned Mission.
32. Fixed the problem that the dialogue text of some NPCs is not normal.
33. Optimized the problem that some NPC plots will continue to interact with players even after they reject them.

<size=25>[0.8.6016 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 20:00 on August 2, 2022
1. All traditional mind skills from  are changed from 4-piece sets to 6-piece sets. But the number of requirements to trigger the effect of the set remains the same, still 2 and 4 pieces.

6. Fixed the problem that the phrase (Spiritual Heavenly Soaring) of the Plume of the Underworld did not take effect.
7. Adjusted the effect of the affix of the Candlelight (Wind Shadow): 
 The description of the effect before adjustment is: for every 10 damage dealt by the Ethereal Power, it increases its motion skill by 30%, which can be stacked for 3 levels and lasts for 40 seconds. 
 The effect before adjustment is abnormal and does not match the description. The actual effect is: for every 10 damage dealt by Ethereal Power, it increases all damage by 360%, can be stacked for 3 layers (total increase is 1080%), lasts for 4 seconds. 
 The adjusted effect is: Ethereal Power to the same enemy to deal 300 damage, so that all their skills power increased by 90%, lasting 4 seconds.

11. Optimized the operation logic of comprehend.
12. Fixed the problem that the game would get stuck when entering the Wave of Monsters battle under certain circumstances.
13. Cancellation of Di Jiang's following status in the immortal shrine of Dijiang.
14. Fixed the problem that props related to the shrine could not be put into Tree Vault.
15. Fixed the problem that the name in the plot of the Ye Linyuan Shrine was incorrect.
16. Fixed the problem that the Mushroom Mansummoned by the heavenly art of theSun Blocking Heavenly Mushroom has no avatar.
17. Fixed the problem that when the plot needs to consume props, the quantity consumed may be incorrect.
18. Fixed the problem that the original sect position was displayed abnormally after the sect was relocated to the Chi You.
19. Optimized the output of the big map BOSS in Huafeng, and improved the output probability of rare materials for forging.
20. Optimized the output of mining devil, increased the refining rare materials.
21. Optimized the output of the large map BOSSes of Wayward Desert and Chi You, and added the output of rare materials for the Outlandish Guqin.
22. Fixed the problem that the reward of Huafeng State does not match the actual one.
23. Optimized the dialogue text of some NPC storylines.

startGameTipDesc252.ch:
<size=25>【0.8.7001 版本更新内容】</size>2022年10月11日21时更新
1.解锁了神器（炼妖壶），炼妖壶的功能如下。
　在战斗中，可在大妖兽虚弱时打开炼妖壶，有概率将其吸入炼妖壶中炼化成壶妖。
　将任意壶妖设置为护卫后，可在战斗中协助自身进行战斗。
　在战斗中被击败时，被设置为护卫的壶妖会为你抵挡致命攻击，并协助你逃离战斗。
　可派遣壶妖外出历练，历练结束后壶妖可获得修为，并有概率获得额外的道具。
2.深度优化了战斗模块，提升了战斗时的性能表现，使战斗画面更加流畅（对底层进行了优化，可能会出现部分词条效果不正常，有问题请及时反馈给我们）。
3.由于本次更新增加了大量图片资源，会使部分图集内容产生变化，当玩家使用了某些修改了图集的MOD，可能会引起游戏画面混乱，若出现此情况，请取消MOD并耐心等待MOD作者修复。

6.优化了部分丹方的必要材料需求，降低了炼丹的难度。

8.新增了逆天改命（悬壶御妖、天级幻灵锅、灵丹妙药、丹精药髓、玉液归元）。

startGameTipDesc252.en:
<size=25>[0.8.7001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 21:00 on October 11, 2022
1. Unlocked the Mythical Gourd; the function is as follows.
a. During the battle, you can open the Mythical Gourd when the Mythical Beast is weak; there is a probability that it will be devoured into the Mythical Gourd to refine into Imp.
b. After setting any Imp as a guard, it will assist itself in battle.
c. When you are defeated in battle, the Imp set as a guard will defend you from fatal attacks and help you escape from the battle.
d. Imp can be sent out for adventures after the training and will be rewarded with the appropriate props.
2. Deeply optimize the battle module, improve its performance, making it more smooth.
3. Added a new mysterious organization adventure which can be triggered in Yongning.
4. Added some new elixirs and more new elixirs will be updated continuously.
5. Optimized the necessary material requirements for some elixir recipes and reduced the difficulty of alchemy.
6. Optimized the operation experience of the alchemy process and optimized the efficiency of alchemy proficiency and the weight of elixir output.
7. Added new Rewrite Destiny (Mirage Pot II, Mirage Pot I, Incredible Elixirs, and so on).
8. Optimized the effect of some of the Rewrite Destiny (Mysterious Shield I, Mysterious Shield II, Mysterious Shield III, Emperor's Legacy, Spiritual Sword I, Spiritual Sword II, Spiritual Sword III, Blood Claw I, Blood Claw II, Blood Claw III).
9. Added 2 sets ofcharacter paintings and some other accessories.
10. Added the function of viewing the skill description of the Mythical Beas in the pause screen of the dungeon.
11. Fixed the problem that when the backpack interface is opened to view the prop details interface, the prop details interface can still be clicked after using the shortcut key to close the backpack interface.
12. Fixed the problem that the Shadowy Finger could not trigger the Fire Star.
13. Optimized the manual filtering function of the sect's Manual Library and now can record filtering preferences.
14. Fixed the problem that the sect's spiritual beasts could not be attracted when using the prop Ghost Grass Serum near the sect in the Wayward Desert and Chi You.

startGameTipDesc284.en:
<size=25>[0.8.8001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 12:00 am on February 15, 2023
1. Tian Yuan Mountain story line has been added.
2. New dungeons have been added
3. Feng Shui Diagram and Exquisite Stone Plate have been added.
4. Talisman and Charm have been added.
5. A series of adventures have been added.      You will be able to accept the quests in the taverns of Huafeng, YunMo and Muxian, and complete the quests to get the Talisman Charts and Talismans stat items.
6. New elixirs (Invisibility Elixir and Vein-reversing Elixir) have been added.
7. New illustrations (Solitary Skylark, Dark Cynosure, Violet Melody, Immortal In White and Carefree Wanderer) will be unlocked after reaching the specific endings, and you will be able to choose a specific Destiny (Nature)(Empyrean Edge, Scorching Eruption, Verdant Quills, Quicksand, Sword Boost) after using the illustration when creating a character.
8. The feature that players can modify the number of NPCs generated when creating an archive has been added (reducing the number of NPCs may improve the performance, but the NPCs may get less active）
9. New interactions between master and disciple have been added (Learning Martial Arts and Taught Martial Arts).
10.New spouse interactions and partner interaction have been added (new dialogues to persuade others to break off the relationship have been added).
11. Now parents can sense when their children are in danger.
12. New interactions with sect disciples have been added （care or bully）
13.The new interaction of inviting NPCs to an adventure has been added.
13. New interaction of inviting NPCs to an adventure has been added.
14. New interactions with Grand Elder and Elders have been added (can ask the sect leaders for additional resources).
15. A new talisman has been added (Ancient Ruins Teleportation Charm). The players can use this talisman to invite other NPCs to enter the battle together, which can be obtained in Feng Shui adventure events.
16. Players are now able to check the Player Statistics after the ending（Currently the archives of old version can only show limited contents and may inlude mistakes, we will add more contents that can be recorded and improve the accuracy in the future updates)
17.  NPCs' AI has been refined.        The NPCs are now more active in forming relationships with others.

startGameTipDesc32.en:
<size=25>[0.8.1036 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 9 PM, 2/7/2021
1. Bug fix: NPC AI
 NPCs would turn down your gifts even when your Affinity was high enough.
 NPCs wouldn't replace their mounts and rings with higher-level ones.
 NPCs would seldom buy and equip Elixirs.
 NPCs would sell very precious items.
 Wrong romantic interactions between NPCs.

12. Bug fix: Lag caused by using multiple items at a time.
13. Optimization: Adjusted animation duration when bosses appear (except when they appear for the first time).
14. Bug fix: Story items would be put into the Temporary Inventory, causing players to be unable to complete missions.
15. Optimization: Removed useless story items given by Jingwei.
16. Bug fix: Players couldn't escape from the battle in Suiren area if they entered there too early.
17. Bug fix: Wrong EXP preview when players were cultivating in their sect after they had reached their Bottleneck.
18. Bug fix: In the Manual Library, the titles didn't match the Manual types.
19. Bug fix: Wrong backstory of Jo's Flying Sword III.
20. Bug fix: Wrong item descriptions.
21. Bug fix: Wrong achievement descriptions.

startGameTipDesc324.en:
<size=25>[1.1.102 Patch Notes]</size>Updated at 12:00 on January 27, 2024
1. Added a new storyline with interactable NPCs: The Illusion Root (triggerable in Hua Feng).
2. Added a new outfit: Empyreal Elegance.
3. Fixed an issue that may occasionally cause the game to freeze when using Enigmatic Stones.
4. Fixed an issue that may cause the learned manual to lose when using Enigmatic Stones to merge manuals.
5. Fixed an issue that may occasionally consume Enigmatic Stones when canceling to use them.
6. Fixed the incorrect VFX display of the Rewrite Destiny: Roiling World.
7. Fixed an issue that may cause the game to freeze due to a failure to display options in Twin Sisters adventure.
8. Fixed an issue that may lead to incorrect triggering NPCs in following plots after declining an NPC's request to end the relationship with a Partner.
9. Fixed an issue that may lead to incorrect counting of actions on the Character page.
10. Fixed the issue of getting useless offering rewards (Sandalwood Scent) in Ethereal Illusion Shrine.
11. Fixed an issue that may occasionally lead to an incorrect display of certain Artifact Spirit's talent description.
12. Fixed an issue that may occasionally lead to an interrupted sect relocation process.
13. Fixed the issue of displaying incomplete names in refining certain imps.
14. Fixed the abnormal Strength assessment of Suanyu imps after refining.
15. Fixed the issue that certain imps (Demonic Eagle and Dreambreaker Mountain Specter) cannot learn battle skills from Imp Adventures.
16. Fixed the issue that some Prescriptions in Chi You and Tian Yuan Mountain cannot be obtained. Now these Prescriptions can be bought from the Market in the Cultivator Alliance of Chi You.

28. Fixed an issue that may occasionally lead to multiplied item effects in Ground of No Return.

32. Fixed the issue that the affix of Firerider (consuming Vitality for Agility bonus) cannot function correctly in Ground of No Return.

<size=25>【1.1.104 版本更新内容】</size>2024年8月15日12时更新

startGameTipDesc328.en:
<size=25>[1.2.101 Patch Notes]</size>Updated at 10:00 on December 27, 2024
[Major Update]
1.Added three new Fate abilities: Lotus Sword's Will, Spirit Sight, and Soul Reaver Sword.
2.Added special NPCs called [Eccentrics]: These NPCs exhibit more extreme behavior compared to regular ones.
[DLC Added]
3.Introduced a new story-based DLC: Five Blooms (requires DLC purchase).
4.Added a digital version of the BaHuang Chronicles (requires DLC purchase).
[Regular Content]
5.Added a new set of illustrations: 幻鳞华彩
6.New character creation feature: Players can now lock one innate destiny.
7.Introduced a new item, Creation Elixir: Can refresh Rewrite Destiny choices during breakthroughs.
8.Added new mounts: Jade Kun of the Wild Horn and Sunbird Feather (obtainable in early story quests).
9.Added the ability to load backup saves within the game.
[Bug Fixes]
10.Fixed an issue where certain invitation locations could not be accessed.
11.Resolved incorrect display of workshop synthesis products.
12.Fixed a bug where the monthly cycle could freeze under certain conditions.
13.Resolved an issue where battles with Xingtian could cause the game to freeze.
14.Enhanced compatibility with certain mods that were unusable after updates.
15.Fixed an issue where controller inputs became unresponsive while retrieving items from the Tree Vault.
17.Fixed an issue where incorrect controller prompts appeared during battles in the Mythical Gourd.
18.Fixed an issue where the merge button for Dragon Spirit from Dragon Mountain Hamlet was unresponsive when using a controller.
19.Fixed an issue where the story button displayed an extra cursor in certain mods.
Updated the mod configuration comparison to the latest version.

startGameTipDesc329.en:
<size=25>【Version 1.2.102 Update Notes】</size>Scheduled for December 28, 2024, at 7:00 PM
1.Fixed an issue where the initial backlash time was displayed incorrectly when selecting the Soul Reaver.
2.Optimized the position detection logic for the Soul Reaver's soul absorption to prevent incorrect detection in certain locations.
3.Resolved an issue where the Talisman Anecdotes quest series could not be accepted under certain conditions.
4.Fixed an issue where the Nether Demon in the Tian xiang story instance would not attack.
5.Corrected an issue where Yin er interaction feedback in certain scenarios did not match the storyline.
6.Fixed abnormal NPC AI behavior after the storyline endings of Lan You and Tian xiang in certain situations.
7.Resolved issues where items could not be obtained properly in specific storylines.
8.Fixed certain storylines involving Lan You that could not be triggered.
9.Enhanced the backup save function to independently record each save.
10.Added compatibility for some mods that were not functioning correctly after updates.

startGameTipDesc33.ch:
<size=25>【0.8.1037 版本更新内容】</size>2021年2月9日12时更新
1.修复了回到主界面时，可能会出现内存泄露导致内存占用异常的问题。
2.优化了NPC的以下AI行为。
　修复了赠送丹药给一丝元魂的NPC后，NPC会跳过重塑肉身的阶段并立即复活问题（正常是需要一段时间进行重塑肉身）。
　修复了NPC在背包满了的情况下依旧会接受赠送道具，导致道具无法正常进入NPC的背包的问题。
　修复了NPC很少主动提升资质的问题。
　修复了NPC很少主动学习并装备更强大的技能的问题。
3.新增了当神通达到了施展条件时，在技能图标上会有特效提示的功能。
4.修复了部分技能无法攻击浮空的敌人（如鲮鱼、长乘等）。
5.修正了一些不正确的NPC对话内容。
startGameTipDesc33.en:
<size=25>[0.8.1037 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 12 PM, 2/9/2021
1. Bug fix: Wrong RAM usage when players returned to the Main Menu.
2. Bug fix: NPC AI
 After receiving the Elixirs, NPCs in Last Breath status would skip Body Reconstruction and revive instantly.
 NPCs would keep receiving gifts after their Inventories are full.
 NPCs would seldom increase their stats.
 NPCs would seldom learn and equip more powerful skills.
3. New: Added a special effect to remind players that their Ultimate Skills can be cast.
4. Bug fix: Some skills could attack enemies in the air (e.g., Carpia and Leonid).
5. Bug fix: Wrong NPC dialogue.

startGameTipDesc331.en:
<size=25>【Version 1.2.104 Update Notes】</size>Update scheduled for December 31, 2024, at 7:00 PM
1.Fixed an issue where the Soul Reaver could cause a freeze when devouring souls under certain conditions.
2.Resolved a problem in the Five Blooms storyline where acquiring a special skill of Bloom Long reverted Players' unique outfit's skill back to its original version.
3.Fixed a bug where the newly purchased outfit, 幻鳞华彩 did not appear in the inventory after being bought from Immortal Wardrobe.
4.Addressed an issue where entering the Peak of Tian Yuan Mountain could cause a freeze in specific scenarios.
5.Optimized some AI behaviors for NPCs with Spirit Sight.
6.Fixed a potential storyline freeze in the Five Blooms Yin'Er storyline due to differences in the player's character gender.
7.Resolved an issue where female player characters were unable to form sworn bonds with Five Blooms characters.
8.Corrected an issue where the destiny obtained in the Tian Xiang storyline was incorrect.
9.Fixed occasional visual glitches in Lan You's character illustration.
10.Optimized certain AI behaviors of the Five Blooms characters.
11.Fixed an anomaly in triggering Lan You’s storyline when using a controller.
12.Resolved interaction errors with Nether Demon when using a controller.
13.Fixed clothing-related errors caused by exploits; all affected clothing has been restored to their default settings.

startGameTipDesc332.en:
<size=25>【Version 1.2.105 Update Notes】</size>Update scheduled for January 8, 2025, at 11:00 AM
1.Fixed an issue where certain actions by eccentrics bypassed the Faithful personality check of NPCs.
2.Resolved a bug where NPCs would mistakenly take out the Soul Reaver or Radiant Lotus while pleading for mercy.
3.Fixed an issue where the Soul Reaver would disappear under certain conditions when the NPC holding it died.
4.Addressed a bug that caused the game to freeze when triggering the Spirit Sight Martial Soul effect during duels with NPCs.
5.Fixed a display issue where the Yin Yang Orb did not appear in the 【Items】 category after being unequipped in the equipment interface (it could still be seen in the 【All】 category).
6.Fixed a bug where consuming certain Lotus Seeds with Lotus Sword Intent would use two seeds instead of one.
7.Resolved an issue where skill enhancement effects given by Ao Yao did not apply to certain skills.
8.Fixed the presence of Five Blooms characters in the Enemies Sect Survivor event where they were not intended to appear.
9.Corrected dialogue errors caused by distress affecting Five Blooms characters.
10.Fixed issues where the illustrations and dialogue text of Five Blooms characters were displayed incorrectly in some scenarios.
11.Resolved abnormal attribute values after realm breakthroughs for Five Blooms characters.
12.Fixed an issue with incorrect fortunes gained in the Tian Xiang storyline.
13.Resolved issues where certain events in the Tian Xiang storyline failed to generate properly.
14.Optimized the difficulty of battles involving cultivators in the Lan You storyline to make them more balanced.

startGameTipDesc333.en:
<size=25>【Version 1.2.106 Update Content】</size>Update scheduled for January 22, 2025, at 8:00 PM
1.Added the Transcendent Enigmatic Stone - Herald of Dawn, which can be obtained by talking to the maid in the Cultivator Alliance's Main Manual Pavilion.
2.Added some follow-up interaction events for the Five Blooms.
3.Added some voiceovers for the Five Blooms.
4.Fixed an issue in markets where items that shouldn't be sellable were being sold.
5.Fixed an issue where NPC AI could skip Last Breath status detection, causing them to seek revenge on the enemies of the Last Breath.
6.Fixed an issue where NPCs in Last Breath would still accumulate hatred with others.
7.Fixed an issue allowing certain lotus seeds to be used on NPCs in Last Breath, causing abnormal AI behavior.
8.Fixed an issue with abnormal logs related to the Immortal Shrine for some NPCs.
9.Fixed an issue causing a game freeze when triggering Transfer Arts under certain conditions.
10.Optimized the issue where Soul Reaver would attack in place under specific circumstances.
11.Fixed an issue where the life skills of the Artifact Spirit (Youling) were ineffective in certain situations.
12.Fixed an issue with the disordered display of temporary backpack item categories.
13.Fixed an issue where allied teammate AI would stop after switching rooms in a Sect battle.
14.Fixed an issue where, under mouse and keyboard operation, pages like Auction, Enigmatic Stone usage, and skill equipping had remnants of controller icons.
15.Fixed an issue on Steam Deck where input fields for bidding prices, mod store searches, etc., would not pop up, making it impossible to enter text.
16.Fixed a compatibility issue between the devouring souls option and certain mods.
17.Fixed the inconsistency between portrait previews in the mod editor and in-game performance.
18.Fixed an issue in the English version where previewing the Accident UI in the mod editor would cause a freeze.

startGameTipDesc335.en:
<size=25>【Version 1.2.108 Update Content】</size>Update scheduled for March 6, 2025, at 12:00 PM
1. Added post-interaction events for Five Blooms:
   - General: Invitation interactions.
   - Ao Yao: Punishing enemies, disrupting rival sects, emergency combat rescues.
   - Lan You: Threatening rival sect leaders.
   - Shuang Ling: Rebuking defamers, rescuing elders, entrusting friends with gifts.
   - Yin'er: Persuading enemies to retreat.
   - Tianxiang: Rebuking defamers, preventing enemies from pursuing.
2. Fixed an issue where special NPC invitations would freeze in dungeons under certain circumstances.
3. Fixed a problem where Five Blooms NPCs would agree with others defaming the player in certain scenarios.
4. Optimized the issue where the Tao Realm dungeon couldn't settle or exit properly under certain conditions.
5. Optimized feedback for Soul Reaver NPCs fleeing when encountering multiple enemies during combat.
6. Optimized the issue where the Spirit Sight Ultimate Skill Soul entry was not unlocked.
7. Fixed the issue where the achievement (Mentored Maven) couldn't be completed under certain circumstances.
8. Fixed the inconsistency between the preview illustrations in the MOD editor and those in the game.

startGameTipDesc336.en:
<size=25>[Version 1.2.109 Update Content]</size>Update scheduled for April 3, 2025, at 12:00 PM
1. Added the Sect Tournament acceleration feature (check "Enable Acceleration" at the bottom left of the Sect Tournament - Points Race interface, or check "Enable Acceleration" at the bottom left of the Points Race deployment interface).
2. Added the feature to toggle the battle status of the Soul Reaver.
3. Fixed issues with Five Blooms Tianxiang's enhanced skill (Lightning Eye) where the consumption of Thunder Surge did not increase the duration, and when there was only one enemy present, it did not increase the range.
4. Optimized some plot descriptions for Five Blooms (including quest guidance and the potential impact of choices).
5. Fixed the issue where there was no Letter following Ao Ya's return in certain situations.
6. Fixed the issue where deaths caused by plot events in certain situations would consume the character's Destiny (Nurture) or Artifacts effects for revival.
7. Fixed the issue where the Sect Tournament's Arena could freeze in certain situations.
8. Fixed the issue where hats were not displayed correctly on units during battles.
9. Fixed the issue where the Elixir Recipe (Imp EXP Elixir) could not be obtained in certain situations.
10. Fixed the mismatch between Jianyi's Heavenly Art description and the visual effects.
11. Fixed the issue with incorrect materials required for Ugly Sage's Demon's Arena.
12. Fixed incorrect dialogue during certain interactions between the player and Ugly Sage.

startGameTipDesc337.en:
<size=25>[Version 1.2.110 Update Content]</size> Update scheduled for April 19, 2025, at 3:00 PM
1.Fixed the issue where in certain situations, dying in instances where true death does not occur would trigger the death-prevention effect of artifacts (e.g., Spar, Sect Tournament, Immortal Tournament, etc.).
2.Fixed the issue where the progress bar would become stuck when loading into the Monster Resisting Altar to defend against the Wave of Monsters in some cases.
3.Fixed the issue where the title (World Champion) could not be unlocked.
4.Fixed the issue where the quest (Distant Sound Waves) could not be completed under certain circumstances.
5.Fixed the issue where some achievements could not be unlocked after clearing the game.
6.Fixed the issue where characters associated with the Illusion Root would refuse invitations.
7.Fixed the issue where the Ao Yao quest (Infiltrate Sect) could not be completed under certain circumstances.
8.Fixed the issue where, after learning a Manual in an event location on the world map and subsequently triggering the Lan You storyline battle, the event might disappear.

startGameTipDesc34.en:

 If a player left an auction before it was over, none of their auctioned items would be sold.

18.修复了水系技能的词条（对被冰冻的敌人造成的伤害增加）没有效果的问题。
19.修复了水系技能的词条（场上每有一个敌人被冻结时，可回复灵力）没有效果的问题。
20.修复了剑系神通骤天剑的词条（每激活一道剑影，可使自身无敌一段时间）的无敌时间不正确的问题。
21.优化了拳系神通巨王拳的效果（每秒按百分比回复体力），改为按固定数值回复体力，避免遇到一些拥有此技能的BOSS，无法被击败的问题。

27.修复了逆天改命双修大法在连续与同一个NPC进行双修时，可能会出现赠送道具效果不生效的问题。

37.修复了在战斗准备界面中查看武技预览时，可能会引发一些异常的问题。

startGameTipDesc57.en:
<size=25>[0.8.2001 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 2 PM, 3/27/2021
1. New areas: Mu Xian and Wayward Desert.
2. New Realms: Soul Formation (Ⅶ) and Enlightenment (Ⅷ).
3. New: Divine Soul Skills (available after breaking through Soul Formation).
4. New: Rule Field Skills (available after breaking through Enlightenment).
5. New main story: Kuafu Chases the Sun.
6. New side story: Tiangou.
7. New dungeons:
 Panlong Mountain
 Rocky Valley
 Secluded Valley
 Exorcism Peak
 Moonfall Mountain
 Stairway to Heaven
 Tao Realm
8. New Mythical Beasts: Jiaolong, Gouchen, Xuangui, Luwu, Chongming, Tiangou, Soulstealer Sword, Priest, Skygate Keeper, Qiongqi, Kui, Bloodspell Carpia, Hellspawn, and Jimeng.
9. 2 new elite monsters.
10. 25 new normal monsters.
11. Optimization: NPC AI
 NPCs will form family relationship more often.
 NPCs will actively increase their Reputation.
12. 2 new rewritten Destinies: Wind Burst and Wood Burst.
13. Threaten and Request options have been added to auctions, and NPCs will talk during auctions.
14. Bug fix: Cooldown reductions were stacked incorrectly.
15. Bug fix: Skills generating clones would increase damage of both the character and their clones.
16. Bug fix: During Wind Motion Skills, character could still cast skills after having transformed into a tornado.
17. Bug fix: Enemies marked by some Ultimate Skills could be mistaken for allies.
18. Bug fix: Water Skill affixes (deal more damage to frozen enemies) couldn't take effect.
19. Bug fix: Water Skill affixes (recover Energy when enemies are frozen) couldn't take effect.
20. Bug fix: Skyfall Sword.
21. Optimization: Titan Fist.
22. Bug fix: Dead enemy clones would drop items.
23. Bug fix: Talking to the turtle in Spiritlock Circle would freeze the game.
24. Bug fix: Array Core's burning damage would increase in Land of Beyond and Land of No Return.
25. Bug fix: Wrong damage calculation for Spiritual Sword I.
26. Bug fix: Wrong damage calculation for Jo's Flying Sword I.
27. Bug fix: Gifted items wouldn't take effect (Training Partner).
28. Bug fix: Damage to self wasn't counted in Lightning Retribution.
29. Bug fix: When Jo's Here! and Skyfall Sword existed at the same time, sword shadows would sometimes get generated non-stop.
30. Bug fix: When Mushroom Power II and transformation skills existed at the same time, skills wouldn't reset to normal after the transformation was over.
31. Bug fix: No Spirit Stone loss every month when Generous was triggered.
32. Bug fix: NPCs in Last Breath status could get their items stolen.
33. Optimization: Battle results between NPCs are now more reasonable.
34. Optimization: Using Portals during combat is easier.
35. Optimization: Adjusted town icons and background images in Yun Mo.
36. Optimization: When skills are being upgraded, skill levels will be shown on the left side of the interface in real-time.
37. Bug fix: Previewing Martial Skills during battle preparation would lead to errors.
38. Bug fix: Some characters' battle models didn't match their portraits.
39. Bug fix: The Select button and Destiny descriptions would overlap on the Rewrite Destiny page.
40. Bug fix: Wrong text display under certain resolutions.
41. Optimization: Some interfaces, skills, and monster sound effects.

1.修复了在道界副本中刷新词条时，可能会出现游戏卡死的BUG。
2.降低了五个镇灵BOSS以及天门引者的伤害。
3.因为我们经验的不足，没有提前和大家公告风身法的修正方案。这是我们自己的锅，我们应该自己承担这个责任。所以我们决定先恢复风身法在持续时间内可以释放技能，直到后续大版本更新新的更多的流派出来之前，都不会对风身法进行修正。0CD是因为叠加机制出错了，是必须要修正的，抱歉，否则我们后面游戏技能框架没法做，包括后面的新神通、法宝等。玩家实际上也是可以通过构筑来接近0CD。另外，其它一些明显被大家弃用的身法（例如蝶变、雷变），我们也会在接下来抽时间逐步强化。我们梳理了一下前期可升级的逆天改命，大部分用3个位置换来的逆天改命强度也是很不够的，导致很多道友也弃用，反而成了污染池。今天晚上我们会先更新加强一部分。包括剑灵（以前是有BUG直接放大了10倍伤害，修了BUG后又太弱，这都是内部测试时间不够的表现）。今晚会增加新的逆天改命，跟屁虫也会化龙（这个承诺过大家）！我们近期会在各州开放一个神秘人物，可以让大家在完成任务后，可以修改个别自己不满意的逆天改命。同时，下周我们会更新一套新的定制立绘，以及与NPC约会的玩法。感谢大家的支持，4月份还有个惊喜送给大家！

startGameTipDesc8.ch:
<size=25>【0.8.1012 版本更新内容】</size>2021年1月28日更新
1.因为云存档出现了一些比较严重的问题，我们紧急关闭了云存档。
　（如需移动或备份存档，请在以下存档目录中操作  C:\\Users\\电脑用户名称\\AppData\\LocalLow\\guigugame\\guigubahuang\\Steam\\CacheData）
2.增加了通灵秘境的天材地宝产出。

5.降低了一些神通的施展条件。

9.修复了主线剧情中后羿可能会无故消失的问题。

11.修复了在获得一些逆天改命时没有背景图显示的问题。
12.修复了先天气运单身贵族每次都出现的问题。
13.修复了与NPC结仇之后无法进行其宗门的问题。
14.修正了星耀宫奇遇的秘籍品质较低的问题。
startGameTipDesc8.en:
<size=25>[0.8.1012 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 1/28/2021
1. Disabled cloud saves due to some major issues.
 If you need to move or backup your saves, please go to this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\guigugame\guigubahuang\Steam\CacheData
2. Optimization: More Heaven and Earth Treasure in Land of the Spirits.
3. Optimization: Special bosses will appear more often and have a chance to drop Heaven and Earth Treasure.
4. Optimization: Players can pick up items from farther away during combat.
5. Optimization: Lowered the requirements for casting some Ultimate Skills.
6. Optimization: Lowered the frequency of getting attacked in Lei Ze.
7. Optimization: Shortened cooldown of all Mystic Realms.
8. Optimization: Adjusted the strength of some monsters.
9. Bug fix: Hou Yi would disappear in the main mission.
10. Bug fix: Players couldn't join the sect or get promoted after winning Sect Tryouts and Promotion Duels.
11. Bug fix: No background images when players rewrite their Destinies.
12. Bug fix: Happy Bachelor would appear every time.
13. Bug fix: Players couldn't complete sect missions after becoming the enemy of some NPCs.
14. Bug fix: Rarity of some Manuals was too low in Celestial Palace Adventures.

5.修复了在使用风系身法的持续过程中，指法武技轮回指的弹道不会返回的问题。
6.修复了在使用风系身法的持续过程中，无法获得爆灵湖的效果的问题。
7.优化了NPC的以下AI行为
　参加拍卖会时，对秘籍的需求更明确，会更积极地对自己需要的道具出价。
　降低了NPC对于突破的需求，使NPC的突破速度下降了。
　NPC会更经常查看其背包中道具，然后将其中可使用的道具进行使用。
　优化了NPC与玩家的交互频率过高的问题。
8.修复了逆天改命李四来也在持续过程中进入下一个房间后，可能会无法使用身法的问题。
9.修复了逆天改命剑灵入门系列的魔剑攻击时使用的资质属性不正确的问题。
10.修复了突破悟道的界面中，无法手动选择放入必要材料，只能自动放入的问题。
11.修复了在邀约场景中，在某些情况下可能会卡在凉亭入口无法移动的问题。
12.修复了在邀约场景中，使用神通可能会导致场景内的NPC卡住，导致邀约的流程无法正常进行的问题。
13.修复了首次与武罗战斗时，在某些情况下，会连续触发两次逃离剧情，导致副本流程与结算不正常的问题。
14.修复了封神天梯在结算时可能会出现错误，导致游戏卡死的问题。
15.修复了在某些情况下，区域大BOSS只会掉落刀法秘籍的问题。
16.修复了当临时背包存在道具的情况下跳过本月时，会导致日期出现异常的问题。
17.修复了当玩家没有参加拍卖会时，NPC的竞拍AI可能会出现问题，导致无法拍到道具的问题。
18.修复了NPC在拍卖会拍得秘籍后，秘籍可能会无法进入背包的问题。
19.优化了当灵力不足时，神通技能图标的显示状态会发生变化。
20.修复了在宗门比试中失败时，也会记录死亡次数的问题。
21.修复了在某些情况下将游戏切换至后台后，游戏内的声音仍然在播放的问题。
22.优化了副本内的传送阵的位置，使其更容易踩上去。
23.优化了部分NPC主动交互时的对话按钮的显示顺序，使所有交互的接受与拒绝按钮的位置更统一。
24.修复了角色人际关系界面中，可能会出现列表中人物信息错乱的问题。
25.修正了部分道具的描述文本。
26.修正了部分技能的图标不正确的问题。
27.修正了部分NPC的对话文本不正确的问题。
28.修正了部分技能的说明文本。

1.优化了部分神通的施展条件不好触发的问题。
　烈火凤：绝技以及身法生成烈焰的持续时间都增加了，使敌人更容易在烈焰中死亡。
　冰天眼：现在击杀有寒霜的敌人也能获得层数了。

12.优化了出售道具的操作。
13.修正了部分逆天改命的出现概率，并对逆天改命进行了一些数值调整。
startGameTipDesc9.en:
<size=25>[0.8.1013 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 1/28/2021
1. Optimization: Some requirements for casting Ultimate Skills were too hard to meet.
 Fire Phoenix: Flames now last longer, making it easier to kill enemies.
 Heavenly Icy Eye: Killing enemies inflicted with Frost will generate stacks.
2. Optimization: Higher chance of getting Ultimate Skills and high-rarity Manuals in auctions.
3. Bug fix: No notifications after killing low-Realm Cultivators from the same faction regarding reduced Reputation.
4. Bug fix: Killing Cultivators from the enemy faction would also result in losing Reputation.
5. Bug fix: Animation was too fast when trying to pick up an item from far away.
6. Bug fix: Some skills didn't show damage dealt.
7. Bug fix: When generating the world map, only 5 of 6 Qi areas would appear. (You need to create a new save. Old saves can only be fixed after a future patch.)
8. Bug fix: Players had to fight themselves in Sect Tryouts.
9. Bug fix: After a battle in East Sea, players would be teleported to Hundred Thousand Hills.
10. Bug fix: Corpse Lord could leech Vitality non-stop.
11. Optimization: Lowered Focus needed for Land of Beyond and Land of No Return.
12. Optimization: Easier to sell items.
13. Optimization: Probabilities of some rewritten Destinies and their stats.
